audit.whatIsWrong: The whole mid-game plan is built on 'Blinding Dart cancels Heimerdinger's auto-attack ... which is his primary sustained damage source'.
audit.why: It is not. Heimerdinger's damage is H-28 G Evolution Turret fire, Hextech Micro-Rockets and CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade — none of which are basic attacks and none of which a blind touches. He has no on-hit passive and no auto-scaling anywhere in his kit. Telling a Teemo that his Q is the answer here is the single most dangerous line in this matchup, because he will walk up on the strength of it.
audit.corrected: Blinding Dart stops only Heimerdinger's own (weak) autos. The lane is decided by dodging CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade and by killing turrets, not by the blind.
sources: champ-data/_kits/heimerdinger.json (all four ability descriptions; no onHit flag anywhere in kitFlags)

audit.whatIsWrong: CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade is described as a flat 'stun grenade'.
audit.why: Riot's text: 'dealing damage to enemy units, as well as stunning anyone directly hit and slowing surrounding units.' Only the direct hit stuns; everything else in the blast is a slow. That changes how you dodge it — you sidestep the centre, you do not have to clear the whole circle — and it changes how much a partial hit costs you.
audit.corrected: Only the direct hit of CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade stuns; the surrounding blast only slows. Sidestep the centre.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet flags 'NO cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere'. Nothing in either layer gives a number.
audit.why: The punishable window here is exact and rank-independent: CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade is 11 seconds flat at every rank, and it is his only lockdown. Hextech Micro-Rockets is 11/10/9/8/7. Teemo's own Blinding Dart is 7 seconds flat at every rank — which also means 'max Q for a shorter cooldown' is not a thing in this lane.
audit.corrected: Wait out the grenade (11s flat), then step up, stack Toxic Shot and Move Quick out before it returns.

audit.whatIsWrong: Hextech Micro-Rockets is described as firing 'in a straight line on a visible charge-up'.
audit.why: Riot's text: 'Heimerdinger fires long-range rockets that converge on his cursor.' It is a converging spread at 1325 range, not a single line — so 'sidestep the line' is not a usable instruction against it.
audit.corrected: Micro-Rockets converge on his cursor from 1325 range; distance, not a sidestep, is what beats them.

audit.whatIsWrong: Ability names: 'H-28G Evolution Turrets', 'UPGRADE!!' (two marks), 'Turret Emplacement'.
audit.why: Data Dragon gives 'H-28 G Evolution Turret' and 'UPGRADE!!!' (three marks). 'Turret Emplacement' is not an ability in his kit at all — UPGRADE!!! empowers his next spell, which on Q produces an upgraded turret.
audit.corrected: H-28 G Evolution Turret; UPGRADE!!!; 'an UPGRADE!!!-empowered turret' rather than a named 'Turret Emplacement'.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer's Level 1 row and early breakdown both open with the boilerplate 'AA-poke + E poison wins almost every melee level 1.'
audit.why: Heimerdinger is not melee. He is a ranged mage whose turret is placed before Teemo can stand still long enough for Guerrilla Warfare, and the row is sided to Heimerdinger anyway — so the sentence contradicts its own row for the second time in this file.
audit.corrected: Reworded to state the actual level 1 problem: he is ranged and his turret beats your auto trade.

audit.why: 50.0% over 304 games is a genuine coin flip and the EVEN framing in the late-game text matches it.

edits.before: Your pattern flips once Q comes online at level 3. Blinding Shot (Q) cancels Heimerdinger's auto-attack during a turret window, which is his primary sustained damage source; blind him the instant he steps forward to proc his turret aggro on you, then walk the poison out before his E stun grenade (CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade) comes out. The grenade is the ability that can lose you the lane — it stuns, and a stunned Teemo inside a three-turret cluster gets chunked for half HP with no W escape available. Pre-emptively place Noxious Trap mushrooms in the tribush and river so you always have vision of his grenade arc. Levels 4-5 are your window to punish: Q is near-maxed, your shroom denial zone is growing, and a Heimerdinger who steps too close to re-establish his turret line walks into your full poke-blind loop on a cooldown he cannot win.
edits.after: Your pattern improves at level 3, but be exact about what Blinding Dart does here: Heimerdinger's damage is turret fire, Hextech Micro-Rockets and the grenade, so a blind only stops his own weak autos. The ability that loses you the lane is CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade, 11 seconds flat at every rank, and only its direct hit stuns — the surrounding blast merely slows, so sidestep the centre rather than trying to clear the whole circle. A stunned Teemo inside a three-turret cluster is chunked for half his HP with no W escape. Wait for the grenade to be spent, then step up, stack Toxic Shot on him or on a turret, and Move Quick out well inside those 11 seconds. Shroom the tribush and river so you see the arc leave his hand. Levels 4-5 are your punish window: he has to walk forward to re-place turrets, and that walk happens on your terms, not his.

edits.before: This is a ranged-vs-ranged poke war, not a melee stomp, and Heimerdinger front-loads his advantage hard. His H-28G turrets arrive before you can safely stand still long enough to go invisible, so Guerrilla Warfare offers almost no safety at level 1 — his turrets auto you the moment you root in place. Take your E first to lay poison on him through auto-attacks during the turret setup phase, but stay at max range and never step inside a full three-turret cluster to get a last-hit. His rocket (W) fires in a straight line on a visible charge-up — watch for it and sidestep, because the burst damage is real. At level 2 he can follow a W poke into the turret field and you have no blind yet to punish the auto follow-up; keep trading at the tip of auto range and give up a cannon if it means staying healthy.
edits.after: This is a ranged-vs-ranged poke war, not a melee stomp, and Heimerdinger front-loads his advantage hard. His H-28 G Evolution Turret arrives before you can stand still long enough to go invisible, so Guerrilla Warfare offers almost no safety at level 1 — the turret shoots you the moment you root in place. Take E first to lay poison on him through auto-attacks during the turret setup phase, but stay at max range and never step inside a full three-turret cluster for a last-hit. Hextech Micro-Rockets converge on his cursor from 1325 range, so distance beats them, not a sidestep. At level 2 he can follow a rocket volley into the turret field and your blind would not have answered it anyway — his damage is not auto-attack damage. Keep trading at the tip of auto range and give up a cannon if it means staying healthy.
